title: Built with opus 5.5, no image model: every line in InkTower is drawn by a pen renderer the AI wrote. (Android+ iOS)
author: sketchbookidletower
selftext:
Hi everyone! Today InkTower finally made it through all the circles of Google Play review hell and got approved. It's live now on both stores:

Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sketchbook.inktower](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sketchbook.inktower)

App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/app/id6806354022](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6806354022)

It's an idle tower defense in a school notebook: the tower shoots on its own, and your finger is the pen. Draw a wall, slash through monsters, loop them in sticky ink. This version also adds the Album, where you trace the tower's parts and weapons yourself and the tower fights in your drawing.

Any feedback in the comments is really appreciated.

comments.author: ripple182
comments.body: pretty cool, this caught my eye as I'm using a similar art style for an eventual steam game, but different genre.  I installed it on Android, took me a minute to understand the line drawing mechanic, I kept trying to draw circles around the starting tower as there's a dotted line there.

replies.author: sketchbookidletower
replies.body: Thank you. I’m sure your game will be exciting and beautiful.

comments.author: Straight-Tea-8564
comments.body: I also use Claude Code and Codex to help with procedural art code, so the pen renderer angle caught my eye. Does tracing parts in the Album only change the tower's appearance, or can the shapes you draw affect how a weapon behaves? Having your own drawing show up in combat is a neat way to connect the art style with the mechanics.

comments.author: Busy-Pudding-5169
comments.body: Cool idea! Currently working on a tower defense game too, only you play as the minions.

comments.author: BuffaloConscious7919
comments.body: This seems calming somehow, nice work

replies.author: ThreeDMK
replies.body: Came to say the same.  It has that sticky visual style that is just, pleasant.

comments.author: Ditex_Design
comments.body: haha good idea, really beautiful art direciton and idea

comments.author: ThreeDMK
comments.body: The Tower meets high school notebook doodle boredom, I 100% approve. :)

comments.author: MyTech_Vibes
comments.body: I feel I'm in math class again, my doodles have come to life! 😂

comments.author: ExhaustedDog
comments.body: Oh this reminds me of drawing ships from Star Wars in an asteroid field using paper and pencil. Then with friends we'd take turns firing at each others' ships aiming with the pencil trying to destroy the other fleet. I miss begin in school in the 90's; came up with the most basic games to pass the time in homeroom.
